summary:
A magnitude 7.0 earthquake struck Tibet on Thursday at 10:33 p.m., killing at least 16 people and collapsing more than 300 houses, state media said. The quake struck the north of the region, near the city of Nagqu, where at least seven aftershocks have been recorded. Injury counts differ, at 54 in one report and 65 in another, and President Xi Jinping ordered an all-out rescue effort focused on search and rescue for survivors and treating the injured.

Typhoon Champi forced Taiwan to shut schools and ground hundreds of flights, and one person died after being swept away by waves on Liuqiu island. The storm is part of disruptions spreading across East Asia, and it is approaching eastern mainland China. Flight cancellations there are expected to affect major airports.

The World Health Organization warned on Thursday that Africa faces a complex Ebola outbreak after the virus spread from east Africa to Nigeria. Nigeria, the continent's most populous nation, announced an imported case of the Bundibugyo strain on Tuesday, the first case in west Africa. Nigeria is the fourth African country affected by the outbreak.

headlines.title: Magnitude 7.0 earthquake kills at least 16 in Tibet
headlines.summary: A magnitude 7.0 earthquake struck Tibet on Thursday at 10:33 p.m., killing at least 16 people and collapsing more than 300 houses, state media said. Injury counts differ, at 54 in one report and 65 in another, and President Xi Jinping ordered an all-out rescue effort.

headlines.title: Typhoon Champi shuts Taiwan schools and grounds hundreds of flights
headlines.summary: Typhoon Champi forced Taiwan to shut schools and ground hundreds of flights, and one person died after being swept away by waves on Liuqiu island. Flight cancellations are spreading across East Asia as the storm approaches eastern mainland China.

headlines.title: WHO warns of complex Ebola outbreak in Africa after Nigeria case
headlines.summary: The World Health Organization warned that Africa faces a complex Ebola outbreak after the virus spread from east Africa to Nigeria. Nigeria announced an imported case of the Bundibugyo strain on Tuesday, the first in west Africa, and is the continent's fourth affected country.

headlines.title: Netanyahu orders West Bank closure preparations after Hebron shooting
headlines.summary: Netanyahu ordered the army to prepare for a full closure of the occupied West Bank after soldiers killed two men near Hebron whom the military said had launched a terror attack. Palestinian militants wounded five Israelis in the attack, days before Israeli elections.

headlines.title: Putin says Russia ready for talks on final Ukraine deal
headlines.summary: Russia is ready to resume three-way talks with Ukraine and the United States, but only on the security parameters of a final peace deal, not a short ceasefire, Vladimir Putin said Thursday. Russia launched three waves of missiles at Ukraine hours after making that statement.

headlines.title: Trump says Musk restored Starlink access in Ukraine
headlines.summary: Trump said Musk had put Starlink access for Ukraine back, but declined to say whether he had contacted Musk about it. Musk had earlier said speed and usage limits were decided by the US military and ultimately the president.

headlines.title: Japanese inflation exceeds 2% for first time this year
headlines.summary: Japan's inflation rose above 2% for the first time this year, according to the September reading. The figure adds pressure on the Bank of Japan to raise interest rates by the end of the year.

headlines.title: Greece passes law banning social media for under-15s
headlines.summary: Greece has passed legislation banning children under 15 from social media, with the rules taking effect on January 1, 2027. Greece is one of seven EU countries seeking an age verification solution with the European Commission.
